reply: Acme Cloud is a customer analytics platform for B2B software companies. It connects product usage, billing, and CRM data into one live model of every account, user, and dollar, then turns it into dashboards, smart alerts, and AI-powered insights. Teams use it to spot churn risk earlier, find expansion revenue, and avoid rebuilding reports in spreadsheets weekly. It serves revenue operations, customer success, product, and finance teams at B2B SaaS companies (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 1-2).

The Starter plan costs $49 per user per month. It includes up to 10 users, 5 data sources, 1 million events per month, ready-made dashboards, and email support with next business day response. It is designed for small teams replacing spreadsheet reporting. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

The Growth plan costs $99 per user per month and includes unlimited users, 25 data sources, 20 million events per month, AI insights and smart alerts, custom health scores, and priority support with a 4-hour response time. It is designed for scaling companies running revenue and product on data. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)
The Starter plan includes 1 million events per month. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Yes, Acme Cloud offers a 14-day free trial for the Starter and Growth plans with no credit card required. The Enterprise plan starts with a 30-minute demo with the team. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Annual billing saves 15% compared to monthly billing for Acme Cloud plans. Prices are listed per user per month, with options for Starter, Growth, and Enterprise plans. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
Your data and questions are never used to train AI models shared across customers. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3-4)

Your data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest with AES-256 encryption. The platform is SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR-ready, with role-based access control and a full audit log of every query and change. You can also choose data residency in the US or EU when signing up. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
Yes, you can choose to have your data hosted in the EU when you sign up with Acme Cloud. Data residency options include US or EU hosting. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Acme Cloud connects natively to Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM integrations. It also integrates with other tools like Stripe, Chargebee, Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 2)

SSO (SAML) is included in the Enterprise plan, which also offers SCIM user provisioning, custom data retention, a dedicated customer success manager, and a 99.99% uptime SLA. The Enterprise plan is designed for global companies with advanced security needs (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3).

Most teams see their first live dashboard the same day they connect a data source. Starter customers onboard with self-serve guided setup, Growth customers get a 60-minute onboarding call, and Enterprise customers receive a dedicated customer success manager with a structured 30-day rollout plan (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3).
Acme Cloud's pricing is listed in US dollars and excludes applicable taxes. There is no mention of payment options in Indian rupees. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)
The Growth plan includes 25 data sources. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Acme Cloud has native connectors for several platforms including Stripe, Chargebee, Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. Zoho CRM is not listed among the native integrations. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 2)

Acme Cloud does not offer an on-premise version for installation on your own servers. The platform is cloud-hosted with data residency options in the US or EU. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
